title: Mermaid wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='27' x2='59' y2='27' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Hair -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='44' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='44' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='13' fill='#FFDAB9'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#1B2A41'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#1B2A41'/>

  <circle cx='59' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#FF9EB5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <path d='M40,54 Q50,50 60,54 L58,64 Q50,62 42,64 Z' fill='#4CC9F0'/>
  <!-- Shell bra -->
  <path d='M42,56 Q45,53 48,56 Q45,58 42,56Z' fill='#F72585'/>
  <path d='M52,56 Q55,53 58,56 Q55,58 52,56Z' fill='#F72585'/>

  <path d='M42,64 Q38,72 40,82 Q44,90 50,92 Q56,90 60,82 Q62,72 58,64 Q50,68 42,64Z' fill='#06D6A0'/>

  <path d='M44,70 Q50,66 56,70' stroke='#05B888' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43,77 Q50,73 57,77' stroke='#05B888' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45,84 Q50,80 55,84' stroke='#05B888' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d='M50,90 Q42,96 38,94 Q42,90 50,92 Q58,90 62,94 Q58,96 50,90Z' fill='#06D6A0'/>
  <path d='M50,91 Q44,95 41,94 Q44,91 50,92 Q56,91 59,94 Q56,95 50,91Z' fill='#05B888'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <path d='M40,56 Q34,62 32,68' stroke='#FFDAB9' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60,56 Q66,62 68,68' stroke='#FFDAB9' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
